newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-MISSING TOP JOCKEY CONTACTS POLICE.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-MISSING TOP JOCKEY CONTACTS POLICE.

text.p: Top jockey Ray Cochrane, who had been reported missing by his wife, has telephoned a police station to say he is well, a police official said on Thursday.
Cochrane, 39, who has chalked up wins in the Epsom Derby, the Irish Derby, the Oaks, the 1,000 Guineas and the Coronation Cup during his career, went missing 12 days ago after a domestic dispute.
"He went away wanting a bit of time to himself," Andrew Gilbert, Cochrane's brother-in-law said. "He is fit and well. Reports that he has gone missing have got completely out of hand."
